summary.text: Rufus Craig is a self-employed attorney with more than 40 years of practice experience and the Libertarian candidate for Louisiana's 6th Congressional District.
He ran for the seat in 2022, when he finished second with 13.0% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Craig earned a B.S. from Louisiana State University in 1978 and a J.D. from Southern University in 1984.

He has been a self-employed attorney since 1984, and the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide says his practice covers criminal defense, family law, probate successions, and juvenile and child-in-need-of-care cases.
Craig ran as a Libertarian for the 6th District in 2022, receiving 13.0% of the vote against incumbent Garret Graves.
He is on the ballot for the seat again in 2026.
